name: unified-ats-jobs-mcp
title: RevClamp TalentPulse - Unified 5-in-1 B2B ATS Jobs & Signals
description: Extract normalized B2B job postings, compensation ranges, workplace classification (REMOTE/HYBRID/ONSITE), and tech-stack hiring signals across Greenhouse, Workday CXS, Ashby, Lever, and SmartRecruiters with zero browser overhead. Independent tool by RevClamp; not affiliated with any ATS vendor.

output.title: Unified ATS Job Postings & Hiring Signal Summary
output.description: Normalized B2B ATS job postings across Greenhouse, Workday CXS, Ashby, Lever, and SmartRecruiters (Default Dataset) and execution/billing telemetry (Key-Value Store OUTPUT).

jobPostings.title: Normalized ATS Job Postings
jobPostings.description: Canonical B2B job postings with compensation ranges, workplaceType, seniorityLevel, techStackKeywords, and prompt-injection sanitized excerpts.

runSummary.title: Run Summary & Telemetry (OUTPUT)
